description: The action is unavailable until both keys and the full slider are complete.
A second completion event cannot invoke the destructive handler again.
The affected-data list is rendered from the captured target.
Emergency exit and the platform cancellation path remain available.
A successful action can carry a separate receipt warning without entering failed retry state.
A receipt warning must be acknowledged by a durable non-blocking sink before the completed surface may close.
A refused or unavailable warning sink keeps the completed warning visible with an honest persistence explanation.
An unpersisted completed warning has an explicit dismiss action and never retries the destructive operation.
Slider authorization reaches the actual handler token exchange after preflight verification.
The path and owner context reset the gate; payload bytes remain in the immutable snapshot and are not reserialized.
The displayed summary is bound to the immutable request identity.
The handler-generated summary is loaded before the two-key surface appears.
An expired preflight cannot authorize a request and exposes a retry route.
Retrying an expired supplied preflight fetches fresh handler details instead of reusing it.
An expired supplied preflight is never rendered or retried as the same object.
The single-use token is sent in a header and never placed in the URL.
A fresh handler summary must match the displayed preflight before DELETE.
A receipt callback failure is reported separately from successful DELETE.
Only validated plain JSON becomes immutable request bytes.
Preflight and DELETE reuse the same canonical body text and bytes.
A non-secret owner context resets the gate and never enters the SHA-256 request hash.
